summary: Klaviyo sync must use per-endpoint pagination, filter, and syncability descriptors, and auth must support named account config selection.
reason: Klaviyo rejects generic sync query params such as page[size]=100 and since on endpoints that do not document them, while campaigns and coupon-codes require resource-specific filters. Operators also need to switch among multiple Klaviyo private keys without rewriting the default config or environment.
validated_outcome: go test ./... and go build ./cmd/klaviyo-pp-cli pass for the Klaviyo module. Focused tests cover page-size suppression and caps, required-filter fanout/skip behavior, default /client exclusion, fanout sync_state reporting, named account switching precedence, and missing named-account errors. Live read-only sync with --agent completed with 37057 records across 41 resources, errored=0; the only warnings were Advanced KDP permission-gated webhook resources. doctor --agent reported a fresh cache with rows for campaigns, coupon-codes, profiles, flows, lists, metrics, events, and segments.
